categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Huaxin New Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of functional films, specializing in smart card substrates. Their product portfolio includes PETG, PVC, ABS, PC, bio-based, and recycled card materials used in various smart cards such as ID cards, bank cards, social security cards, and transportation cards. The company also develops security anti-counterfeiting elements for electronic documents and has expanded into environmental films and automotive electronic components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including calendering, coating, extrusion (single and multilayer), and casting processes. It integrates imported equipment from Germany, Italy, and Japan to ensure high-quality and stable production. Core technologies cover polymer material formulation, film production, and security element embedding, supported by over 70 patents and national-level R&D platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic listed companies in smart card manufacturing, government document production units such as the Ministry of Public Security's research institutes, and international card manufacturers like G&D, Linxens, and IDEMIA. The end markets span financial payment cards, mobile communication, social security, transportation management, and government identification documents.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Jiangsu Province and subsidiaries in Shanghai. It serves both domestic and international markets, with overseas sales accounting for about 26% of revenue. Emerging markets in Southeast Asia and Africa are identified as new growth areas, alongside global electronic document markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Huaxin New Material is positioned upstream and midstream in the smart card industry supply chain, focusing on the development and production of core substrate materials and security components that are essential inputs for downstream smart card manufacturers and document producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in low-carbon and environmentally friendly materials such as PETG, PC, bio-based, and recycled polymers. It plans to introduce four advanced international production lines to accelerate industrialization of these materials. Strategic cooperation along the industry chain and global market expansion, especially in electronic document security solutions, are key R&D and business development directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of functional film products and smart card substrates. The company provides customized materials tailored to client specifications, with sales recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns income from government subsidies and minor investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Huaxin New Material is a leading domestic player in the smart card substrate industry, recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a key supplier for China's second-generation ID cards. It holds a significant market share in the mid-to-high-end smart card material segment, competing with both domestic and international material suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 318.7 million, a slight decrease of 2.54% from the previous year, while net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 23.46% to RMB 50.6 million. Total assets grew by 20.78% to RMB 928.6 million, reflecting ongoing investments and capacity expansion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with increasing profitability and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly, and technologically advanced smart card substrates that meet stringent performance criteria for durability, printability, and security. Its differentiated product lines include recycled and bio-based materials certified by global standards, supporting sustainability trends and regulatory compliance. Strong R&D capabilities and close collaboration with leading customers enable rapid innovation and customized solutions, enhancing competitive advantage.
